decisions.reason: Changing the pareo artwork dimensions does not alter the required fabric, ICC-profile handling, colour-reference basis, or production colour values.
The source requests resized artwork but does not require the Technical Sheet or its documented colour references to be changed.
The dimension change does not change production readiness, CMYK colour mode, or seamless repeat construction; the PDF question does not establish a new output-format decision.
The global artwork-dimension Requirement governs the resized canvas independently; the basket-weave design, palette, scale, texture, and edge treatment remain unchanged.
The resize does not change the mustard block-colour pareo's colour layout or border-width options; dimensions are maintained by the separate artwork-dimensions Requirement.
The resize does not alter the terracotta block-colour pareo's colour reference, border colour, or border-width options; dimensions are maintained separately.
The global artwork resize does not change the Zebra print's selected design, scale, palette, texture, or border-free edge treatment.
